scene_demo.reason_continue: {score} > {threshold}, the current query is highly continuous with the historical scene; keeping the current Scene.
scene_demo.reason_shifted: {score} ≤ {threshold}, the current query has low semantic continuity with the historical scene; starting a new Scene.
scene_demo.reason_first_scene: The current Query is the start of the first Scene (turn {turns}), so a new Scene starts and the model is not called.
scene_demo.reason_min_turns: The current Scene turn count ({turns}) is below the min protected turns, so the current Scene is kept and the model is not called.
scene_demo.reason_max_turns: The current Scene turn count ({turns}) has reached the max scene turns, so a new Scene starts and the model is not called.
scene_demo.summary_continue_text: The current Query continues the existing Scene, which stays open; a summary is generated after a later SHIFT or session close.
scene_demo.summary_continue_hint: CONTINUE does not close the Scene, so no summary model is called this turn.

scene_demo.summary_shifted_hint: The summary targets the Scene before the split and excludes the Query that triggered SHIFT.
